description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:96,144 — Both public functions return `crate::Result<ValidatedPath>`. Dropping the return value silently discards both the validation outcome and the `ValidatedPath` (anchor_index, depth). Adding `#[must_use]` causes the compiler to warn if the result is discarded, preventing a class of caller bugs. Fix: annotate both functions with `#[must_use = "discarding the result silently skips chain validation"]`.
title: [rusty/pkix-chain] #[must_use] missing on verify_chain and verify_chain_default
